title: PBKDF2 iteration floor uses strncmp prefix — fragile coupling
description: fd.c:1704: strncmp(op.algo, 'pbkdf2', 6) == 0 encodes PBKDF2 identity in the framework using a string prefix, coupling the framework to a naming convention that is not formally enforced anywhere. The framework is running this check before lookup, so it doesn't know which provider will handle the request — it's inferring algorithm class from the user-supplied name. Suggested rewrite: add u32 min_iterations to struct crypto2dev_algo_ops (0 = no minimum). After lookup, if ops->min_iterations && op.iterations < ops->min_iterations, return -EINVAL. This moves the policy to the provider where the knowledge lives, and makes the check declarative instead of string-matching.
